text:
Priya: Quick sync — after last week's launch we need to lock scope for a 2-week stabilize wave. Mini-epic proposal in doc: crash hotfixes (P0/P1), a UX polish pass, and one small perf improvement. Can owners confirm what's must-fix vs nice-to-have? https://go/release/mini-epic :eyes:
Sam: Looked through Sentry — 6 P0 regressions and ~12 P1s. P0s need immediate patch. I'll own P0s and a fast follow deploy.
Miguel: I can take the autocomplete jitter (P1) but prefer to schedule it after the hotfix patch to avoid rollout risk.
Jess: +1. Proposal: split into a 3-day hotfix sprint (only P0/P1 crash fixes), then a 7–10 day polish sprint for UX & small improvements, with a canary phase between.
Priya: Acceptance for hotfixs should be: reproducible test case, no new e2e flakiness, and a rollback runbook. Also gating metrics: error rate, p95 latency, memory.
Sam: I'll add the gates to the runbook. Quick snippet for gates:
```
- error_rate < 0.5% of baseline
- p95 latency regressions <= 20% above baseline
- memory < 80% of prod pool during rollout
```
Miguel: Customer request from ACME for ranking tweak — low risk but requires eval harness and A/B. Can we put it in polish sprint as opt-in beta?
Ava: Yes, slot ACME ranking into the polish sprint as a 5% canary if the eval passes. I'll own the eval harness.
Priya: Who will own rollout monitoring/dashboards? We need thresholds and alerting on infra + quality metrics.
Miguel: I can own dashboards and alerts. Will need threshold signoff and a quick smoke test list.
Jess: @Miguel set alerts to #release-war-room and add an automated post-deploy smoke run. I'll write the canary policy and doc.
Sam: One coordination Q — are we doing a freeze EOD today (no new features) so eng can focus on fixes?
Priya: Freeze features EOD PST. If anyone is blocked by that call it out now.
Miguel: Not blocked.
Ava: No blockers from my side.
Jess: Not blocked, will create the canary policy PR shortly.
release-bot: Deployment window reserved: 2025-03-28T22:00Z for hotfix rollout.
Priya: Thanks team — I'll update the roadmap doc with the mini-epic slices and share a final checklist by 10:00am PST tomorrow. :thumbsup:
